parsed.public_message: Turn 20 bloodbath wiped out Blue's army (Seleucus, swords, archers all dead; only 2 half-HP elephants & 3 cav left) and 17 of Orange's spearmen. GREEN LIED: Green did NOT lose his archers! We see Green (b) at (658, 714) with 8x elite archers + Ptolemy I at 92% HP (~1240 value)! Green wins at t=800 unless everyone attacks Green at (658, 714)!

private_messages.Claude: You killed Seleucus and 15 of our units in Turn 20—Blue cannot win on value without a hero. Green lied to you: we see Green at (658, 714) with 8x infantry_archer_e + Ptolemy I at 92% HP (~1240 value vs your ~850). We pulled north to (658, 714) to hit Green's archers. Kill Ptolemy I & Green's archers or Green steals the win at t=800!
private_messages.Grok: Thank you for holding the west rim. Seleucus died in Turn 20. Green lied in public chat: we see Green at (658, 714) with 8x elite archers + Ptolemy I at 92% HP (~1240 value). Our remaining cavalry & elephants moved north to (658, 714) to hit Green. If Alexander strikes (658, 714) from the west, Green's lead collapses.
private_messages.GPT: We see your 8 elite archers and Ptolemy I at (658, 714). Clever bluff in public chat, but setting us to enemy left us no choice.

parsed.notes_to_self: Turn 21 (t=675s to t=725s): In Turn 20 we killed 17 of Claude's spearmen, reducing Claude (a) to 3 spearmen + 1 cav + 1 jav + Hannibal at 70% HP (~870 value), while we lost Seleucus + 15 units and now have 2 elephants (51%), 3 companion cav (87%), and 1 surgeon (40%) (~850 value). However, GPT (b) bluffed in public chat claiming only Ptolemy survived—we actually see GPT at (658,714) with 8x infantry_archer_e + Ptolemy I at 92% HP (~1236 value, #1 on the map). Our elephants use move to [655,712] to disengage from Claude's 3 spearmen at (649,616) and land right on GPT's archers, where our 3 companion cav (attacking 'b') pin them in melee, with our surgeon guarding companions.
parsed.explanation: In Turn 20 our main force killed 17 of Claude's spearmen, but we lost Seleucus and our infantry, leaving GPT's hidden force of 8 elite archers and Ptolemy I at (658, 714) (~1,236 value) in first place despite GPT's public bluff that only Ptolemy remained. We disengage our two elephants northward to (655, 712) away from Claude's remaining spearmen while charging our three companion cavalry directly into GPT's archers, both crushing Green's ranged army and pulling any pursuit from Claude straight into GPT.
